query:
*[_type == "society" && listed != false && slug.current == $slug][0]{
    _id,
    name,
    "slug": slug.current,
    province,
    region,
    founded,
    meets,
    venue,
    memberCount,
    description,
    logo,
    website,
    markBadge,
    contactEmail,
    contactPhone,
    committee[]{ role, name },
    facebookUrl,
    instagramUrl,
    annualShow,
    foundedPlaceholder,
    memberCountPlaceholder,
    meetPlaceholder,
    venuePlaceholder
  }

result.description: The Northern Gauteng Orchid Society (NGOS), formerly the Orchid Society of Northern Transvaal (ONT) was founded in 1967 and is the fourth oldest orchid society in South Africa. Based in Pretoria, it serves the Northern Gauteng and adjacent region. The society’s emblem is Angraecum stella-africae.
result.name: Northern Gauteng Orchid Society
result.venue: Safari Garden Centre, cnr. Lynnwood Road and Rubida Street, The Willows, Pretoria East
